name: Codex
description: Codex CLI session supervisor — routes permissions and notifications to iPhone

tools.name: permission_request
tools.description: Routes a Codex tool permission prompt to iPhone for approval. Blocks until the user approves or denies.

tools.name: session_active
tools.description: Registers or updates a Codex session. Called by the PostToolUse hook after each tool execution.

tools.name: session_stop
tools.description: Marks a Codex session as stopped and removes it from the active session list.

tools.name: notification
tools.description: Pushes a transient alert to iPhone for Codex status updates.

tools.name: tool_executed
tools.description: Notifies that a tool call completed, resolving any pending permission block for that tool.
